plugins.cameraPermission: Ridzo uses your camera to take before and after photos of each job.

plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: Ridzo uses your location while you are online to send you nearby breakdown jobs and show customers how far away you are.
plugins.locationAlwaysAndWhenInUsePermission: Ridzo uses your location while you are online or on a job — including when you use other apps or lock your phone — so jobs keep reaching you and customers can see you on the way. It is never used while you are offline.
